title: Resolve current code locations back to persisted intent
preconditions: Use code evidence pinned to refund.go lines 3-4 at base, remapped to lines 5-6 at head, and an accepted criterion linked by an explains relation to the evidence-owning Item.

steps.action: Resolve a head location at refund.go line 6 against the remapped evidence.
steps.expected_result: It matches with a current locator, and does not match another commit when no locator is available.

steps.action: Query traceability --ref using the head location through every page.
steps.expected_result: The result returns the exact criterion, owning evidence Item and persisted path to the matching reference, without unrelated paths.

expected_result: Current source locations are a reproducible entry point to documented intent.
